translations.seg-0001: Hey, guess what? Next month I'm going to Jingdezhen to learn pottery!
translations.seg-0002: What? Seriously? What big move are you pulling now?
translations.seg-0003: I just want to find a master and really learn properly. A full-on immersive experience. I hear the handmade-craft vibe there is amazing.
translations.seg-0004: Nice! Then you should swing by Taoxichuan while you're there. The art market is top-notch, with loads of hidden-gem little shops.
translations.seg-0005: Yes, exactly, I want to hunt for some good finds. I hear you can even haggle, so I'm going to score some serious bargains.
translations.seg-0006: Hahaha, don't go overboard. Handmade stuff is expensive.
translations.seg-0007: Don't worry, I know what I'm doing. I'll bring you back a cup.
translations.seg-0008: Yay! Then I'm calling dibs on one. Remember to post a vlog!
